data.name: A Case of Missing Identity
data.detailed_description:
Try My Other Game!

Waiting for A Case of Missing Identity to release? Try my other game while you wait - Veins Like Tapeworms! With 6 endings, 100,000 words, 8 chapters and over 250 illustrations, the miserable fate of Demian Zhao is sure to unnerve you!


About the Game

From the creator of Veins Like Tapeworms, A Case of Missing Identity is a point-and-click horror/tragedy visual novel, about how to be human when your existence is everything but.

NO GENERATIVE AI WAS INVOLVED IN THE MAKING OF THIS GAME!!

Synopsis

You awaken alone, in a world unfamiliar to you. It is the world of heroes and Tethers - Humans, as they call themselves. You know nothing, except for this:

You are not a Human. You are the shadow of your Tether, a girl who haunts your dream but whose face you've never seen.

This city is not your home, but you can learn why others make it so. Wander the empty halls, slip into the living quarters of stray Humans, and learn what makes them tick. Listen to their plights, break their wills, or put an end to their story; the choice is yours, but it will shape who you are.

Every step closes the distance between you and the shoes you wish to fill, and every choice sculpts another detail in the pattern of your existence. Eventually, if you run far enough and mold yourself into the perfect shadow, you may even be able to slip into the life of your Tether and dance as her copy.

But...

Is that really the life you want, though?

Features

*Please note this game is currently in development. Information such as ending counts, wordcounts, gameplay mechanics, etc. are subject to change.

🦋 A defined protagonist, Perdita!

Players will slip into the new life of a lonely 4-armed monster with a deep-seated heartache, who was recently spun into existence for a world that was not built for her. After gaining consciousness in a body that can barely stay intact, it's up to players to fill in the blanks of who Perdita is and shape who she will become. Despite that, she is not a blank slate character; Perdita has thoughts and emotions of her own, regardless of what path you send her down.

Every choice made is a thought in her own head, and every trait gained is one that she can reasonably form. A player simply refines her personality.

🦋 A soft-spoken, horror-tragedy story told in 5 Acts!

A Case of Missing Identity's story unfolds itself through 5 Acts - The Inception, The Formation, The Procession, The Completion, and The Cannibalization. Although the base of each Act will stay the same (wander the apartment building Perdita was formed in, slip into the homes of residents, and shape their immediate future with her actions), no two play-throughs will be the same. All Humans can suffer different outcomes in each Act, and the Distortions that Perdita meets will change based on what you did and when. The Traits you let Perdita earn will shape how each Act unfolds and how she interacts with the world around her.

*Please note the demo's contents only provide The Inception and the first half of The Formation!

🦋 6 heart-wrenching endings to discover!

With how hands-on a player is to be in shaping the course of Perdita's identity, it's only natural there are multiple ways the story can end. With over 6 finales to the story - each grand and unique in their own way - and countless variations leading up to how the pieces have to fall, a player is sure to be shocked and unnerved by what they've made Perdita into.

Can you find the happy ending? Can you find the world where Distortions are allowed to be happy?

🦋 A Trait system that changes the story with each Act!

With each choice Perdita makes, her personality shifts and changes into something new; these form into Traits over time. Traits can be as minor as changing what information she picks up on a glance-through, or as major as locking or unlocking fates to dole out to those she meets. Shape her into an observant figure who holds no mercy towards Humans, a wary mind who keeps her distance from Distortions, or a volatile heart that runs toward happiness at all costs. 

Mix and match a variety of traits by choosing what thoughts and actions Perdita allows into her mind. Just remember: their fates depend on her identity.

🦋 5 strange and unique Distortions to meet and befriend!

Draconic Mania.

The One in the Lotus.

Wisteria's Heavenly Knight.

Wrath's Divinity.

Our Beautiful Vision.

These are the title of the Distortions that Perdita can meet through her story. They do not wield names like ordinary Humans, instead sporting a title that distills who they are into a neat, digestible phrase. Every Distortion has a story of their own to reveal during the course of gameplay, and the information they divulge depends on who Perdita is. From a cruel, mirror-bound Distortion reaching for a holiness not meant for her, to an erratic dragon whose nature is the product of a tragedy, no two monsters are the same. Their words and actions will change who Perdita becomes, as well, shaping her moral compass and what she believes is right.

If you learn enough of a Distortion's past throughout the Acts, you might even be able to influence their future at the end of it all.

🦋 An immersive ambience!

​Tired of visual novels that simply loop one generic song on repeat, with no regard for sound effects to coordinate with in-game events? A Case of Missing Identity is your one-stop shop; the game's ambience has been meticulously crafted for the utmost listening experience to go alongside the story. Headphones highly recommended.

data.short_description: A point-and-click horror/tragedy visual novel about melding your perception of the world around you. Walk around, drive people to their death, and shape Perdita's existence. Remember: The flesh-sin is nothing. Before she can become everything, you must make her into something.

content_descriptors.notes:
A Case of Missing Identity is a horror visual novel that is not suitable for children under 17 or for people that are easily disturbed. This game contains major themes regarding suicide. Please play at your own risk.

Additionally, this game contains heavy themes of: nongraphic depictions of suicide, mental breakdowns, murder, blood/gore, (implied) online grooming of a minor, body horror, depression/self loathing, and (brief) gender dysphoria.

An in-depth content warning system is provided in both the demo and the full game. This system can be completely disabled, only alert players to the themes itself that are about to appear on a per-scene basis, or provide an in-depth explanation of each theme and how it appears in the upcoming scene.
